title_en: 1+1+balcony apartment for sale on Kavaja street near the Kadiu bus stop €129,000!!!
description_en: 1+1+balcony apartment for sale on Kavaja street near the Kadiu bus stop €129,000!!! Net area 63 m² Orientation south-east for light and sun throughout the day, unobstructed view. Typology 1 living room + kitchen, corridor that divides the living room that connects to the balcony, the spacious toilet with windows for ventilation and natural lighting and the bedroom. 5th floor without elevator. The environment is completely restored and the terrace is insulated with quality materials. Well-maintained existing building. The apartment has regular mortgage documentation, and is sold with credit.
